headline: Allcargo Global Limited commences trading on NSE and BSE following demerger from Allcargo Logistics Limited
sum: Allcargo Global Limited, the demerged entity from Allcargo Logistics Limited, commenced trading on NSE and BSE on July 3, 2026. The demerger represents a restructuring of Allcargo Logistics' business verticals into separate listed entities.
detail: Allcargo Global Limited was created through a demerger from Allcargo Logistics Limited and commenced trading on both NSE and BSE on July 3, 2026. The demerger involved separation of business lines into distinct listed entities, allowing shareholders of Allcargo Logistics to receive shares in Allcargo Global on a defined exchange basis. The transaction required NCLT approval under the scheme of arrangement provisions and compliance with stock exchange listing norms for post-demerger equity issuance and public float requirements.
